question: Explain why the net charge of an electric dipole is zero but the electric field due to it is not zero.

options.A: The net charge is zero, so the electric field is zero everywhere outside the dipole
options.B: The charges are separated, so their electric fields do not cancel at every point even though $+q+(-q)=0$
options.C: The dipole field is non-zero only because both charges are positive
options.D: The field is non-zero because electric field depends only on total charge
